text:
maria: Heads-up: planning a coordinated rotation for partner-service SA keys + KMS rewrap for Vault-stored ciphertexts. Target window Tue 2026-04-07 03:00-04:00 UTC. Need infra + oncall + sec signoff.
ashok: +1 — what's the scope exactly?
maria: Short version: vendor payload leaked encrypted blobs yesterday. The blobs are valid ciphertexts encrypted with our GCP KMS key version v1. We need to: rewrap ciphertexts to new key version, rotate service account keys used by the connector, and tighten Vault RBAC for the partner path.
parker: I can run an Ansible playbook to automate this: create new SA key, patch k8s secrets, call Vault transit rewrap endpoint for each ciphertext, and then revoke old keys. Prefer staged run (canary -> all).
olivia: We also need audit evidence (who touched what). Can we enable per-request audit logging for Vault during the window and forward to long-term storage (GCS) before rotating?
maria: Yes. Plan: enable audit device to file + remote forward for 24h retention. Will capture vault-audit logs to gs://redwood-sec-audit/partner-rotations/2026-04-07/
parker: Rough Ansible task flow I want to run (short):
```yaml
- name: create new SA key
  gcp_iam_service_account_key:
    service_account_email: partner-service@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com
    state: present
    key_algorithm: KEY_ALG_RSA_2048
    private_key_type: TYPE_GOOGLE_CREDENTIALS_FILE
  register: new_key

- name: patch k8s secret with new key
  kubernetes.core.k8s:
    state: present
    definition: ...

- name: rewrap ciphertext via Vault transit API
  uri:
    url: "https://vault.redwood.internal/v1/transit/rewrap/partner-service"
    method: POST
    headers:
      X-Vault-Token: "{{ vault_token }}"
    body: '{"ciphertext":"{{ item }}"}'
    status_code: 200
  loop: "{{ ciphertext_list }}"
```
parker: The playbook will produce a mapping file old->new ciphertext and a signed manifest.
ashok: For RBAC tightening, what policy changes? We should restrict partner-service/* to only the minimal roles and remove create role from app-team until rotation completes.
maria: Proposed Vault policy patch (minimal):
```
path "transit/encrypt/partner-service" {
  capabilities = ["update"]
}
path "transit/decrypt/partner-service" {
  capabilities = ["update"]
}
path "secret/data/partner-service/*" {
  capabilities = ["read"]
}
```
maria: We'll remove any wildcard admin bindings on the app-team group for the rotation window and reapply after validation.
olivia: On audit side: will configure audit device + remote sink and add a quick query to verify there are no unexpected fails post-rotation. I can take ownership of the audit-forward task.
sec-oncall: Oncall checklist:
- [ ] Verify runbook link posted to #incidents and pinned
- [ ] Ensure a restore snapshot of Vault (snapshot time: 02:55 UTC)
- [ ] Confirm runbook rollback steps and IAM revocation commands
- [ ] Paging rules updated for 03:00 UTC window

maria: Runbook draft: https://confluence.redwood/infrastructure/partner-rotation-draft (please review). Rollback notes included: re-insert old SA key into k8s secret, rewrap back (if we kept old key version) and rollback RBAC by reapplying saved policy.
parker: One technical note: Vault transit rewrap requires the ciphertext to have been encrypted with a key in Vault transit. Our pipeline produced ciphertexts by encrypting plaintext after KMS decrypt -> vault transit encrypt? There's mixed tooling. I added a conversion step to canonicalize ciphertexts to vault-transit format before rewrap.
nashok: Do we need KMS key rotation also (cloud KMS)? We should create a new key version and use that for any future encrypts; but rewrap in Vault is independent as long as transit key is rotated too.
maria: Plan: create new KMS key version v2, update our encryption pipeline to use v2 AFTER we've rewrapped and validated. We will keep v1 for 72h before destroying.
parker: Ops timeline:
- 03:00: start audit forwarding + snapshot
- 03:05: run canary on 10 ciphertexts + verify application decrypts
- 03:20: if canary ok, run batch rewrap (parallel)
- 03:40: rotate SA keys and patch k8s secrets; restart pods incrementally
- 03:50: verify services healthy + spot-check logs
- 04:00: re-enable normal RBAC and stop audit-forwarding

olivia: I'll run canary verification tests and watch logs. Will post results here.
sec-oncall: I will be on pager during window; if any panic, call 1-800-ONCALL :)
